name: Twist Bioscience Corporation
sector: Healthcare / Life-science tools (synthetic DNA, NGS applications)
moat_justification: Silicon-chip DNA synthesis platform with real scale and process leverage — revenue $245.1M → $313.0M → $376.6M (FY2023-25) and gross margin over the last five fiscal years of 39.1% (FY2021) → 41.4% (FY2022) → 36.6% (FY2023) → 42.6% (FY2024) → 50.7% (FY2025) (fundamentals.json), 52.8% in Q3 FY2026 — but no demonstrated return on capital: roic_proxy is deeply negative in every one of the last five years (-103.5% FY2021, -45.2% FY2022, -50.9% FY2023, -70.8% FY2024, -37.1% FY2025 in fundamentals.json) and conservative owner's earnings are positive in 0 of the last 5 years, so there is no ROIC history above the cost of capital to support a 7+. Competition is from far larger tools companies (IDT/Danaher, GenScript, Agilent, Illumina) plus benchtop enzymatic challengers, and SBC of $64.5M in FY2025 (~17% of revenue) keeps diluting holders at 3.5%/yr. A 5 gives CAP = 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 13 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.5%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2018, 2019 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
one_liner: Real silicon-platform DNA synthesis franchise with 20%+ revenue growth and gross margin up to 50.7%, moat 5/10 — but owner's earnings are negative in all of the last 5 years (TTM base -$2.59/share on ttm.py legs, pinned because FY2025 ended 13 months ago; normalized 3-yr median -$2.34/share; SBC $66.5M TTM) — Tier F on this screen; it does not clear 15% at any price on current numbers and no hurdle-clearing price is computed on a negative base. The guided adjusted-EBITDA breakeven in Q4 FY2026 is a re-rating story, not yet an owner's-earnings story.
moat_for: Proprietary silicon-based DNA synthesis platform: high-throughput, miniaturized synthesis gives a structural cost/throughput position in genes and oligo pools that traditional column synthesis cannot match at scale
Scale and share gains in the numbers: revenue $245.1M (FY2023) → $313.0M (FY2024) → $376.6M (FY2025), 14 consecutive quarters of sequential growth through Q3 FY2026, ~2,650 customers in Q3 FY2026
Gross margin expansion evidencing process leverage: 36.6% (FY2023) → 42.6% (FY2024) → 50.7% (FY2025) in fundamentals.json, 52.8% in Q3 FY2026

Embedded workflow position across both segments — DNA Synthesis & Protein Solutions and NGS Applications (target-enrichment panels) — with AI-driven drug-discovery demand (therapeutics revenue +49% YoY in Q3 FY2026; Lilly TuneLab collaboration)
moat_against: No demonstrated returns on capital: owner's earnings positive in 0 of the last 5 years, roic_proxy deeply negative in fundamentals.json (-50.9% FY2023, -70.8% FY2024, -37.1% FY2025) — the franchise has never earned above its cost of capital

Giant, well-funded rivals on every line: IDT (Danaher) in oligos/synthesis, GenScript and Azenta GeneWiz in gene synthesis, Agilent and Illumina in NGS enrichment — plus enzymatic benchtop synthesis (DNA Script, Telesis Bio) threatening the centralized model
SBC is a heavy and rising real cost: $30.3M (FY2023) → $50.9M (FY2024) → $64.5M (FY2025) → $66.5M TTM, ~17% of FY2025 revenue; diluted share count up 3.5%/yr (53.9M FY2022 → 59.8M FY2025 → 61.7M TTM)
Customer and funding concentration: NGS top-10 accounts are a large share of that segment's revenue and many customers are VC-funded biotechs whose demand depends on the biotech funding cycle
Operating leverage unproven: SG&A was ~66% of FY2025 revenue in the filed statements and the operating loss was still $136.3M on $376.6M of revenue
